More about Climate City

Frequently asked
questions

Need more support?WhatsApp Us
How can I contact the team?

Call +234 708 206 4914 or use the enquiry form to prepare a WhatsApp message for the Climate City team.

Where is Climate City planned?

The proposed community is in Nasarawa State, Nigeria. Contact the team for project information.

Can I discuss a partnership?

Yes. Tell us about your organisation and the area you would like to contribute to, such as education, hospitality, culture or community services.

How can I enquire about investment?

Send the team a message about your interest. Climate City is in pre-development; opportunities and delivery phases depend on studies, approvals, funding and specialist partnerships.

Where can I explore the project?

Visit Explore City for the conceptual masterplan and destinations, or read About Climate City for the project vision.
